answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making every identity pay in verifiable effort before it carries any weight. A newcomer starts at a flat delta: nothing is granted, and it must earn each unit of standing by doing work that established peers counter-sign. Reputation accumulates like onyx laid down in thin bands, one attested epoch at a time, and an echo of freshly minted keys rings hollow because it has no history behind it. A farm that opens ten thousand accounts gets ten thousand silent shells, since voting power follows witnessed tenure rather than account count.
